title: linum tauricum subsp. serbicum
intro: Linum tauricum subsp. serbicum, commonly known as Serbian flax, is a plant species within the Linaceae family, characterized by its blue or purple flowers and slender stems. The health benefits of Serbian flax include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The plant is said to possess therapeutic actions such as soothing and calming the nervous system, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Serbian flax include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
